item: Item 1 (quiz how-to for ~/private/xschem-private): skeptic check of the scout map. Read on 2026-11-21 with this tree at HEAD 7c77f3594 (NOT d36cb429e plus uncommitted work: the 1724/1657 work is committed) and the private tree at a464b7f6b, branch assembler, no modified tracked file. Nothing was built or run except read-only greps, cmp, `git apply --check`, and two plain tclsh text scripts of my own in the scratchpad. Verdict in one line: the map's mechanism, wiring, suite description, dependency table and the "80 of 82 proofs agree" claim all survive an independent re-check; seven statements are stale or wrong (the bank is no longer uncommitted, the doc path and acceptance rows contradict the lead's own PLAN.md, the crash lore predates issue 0663, two smaller ones), and about a dozen facts the how-to needs are missing.
confirmed: ENGINE, SUITE, SPEC UNCHANGED SINCE THE COMMIT: `git diff d36cb429e HEAD --stat` over the four new files lists only src/startup_quiz_bank.tcl; `git diff HEAD` over all ten files of the commit is empty. Commit d36cb429e touches exactly the ten files the brief names.

MECHANISM, read in /home/analog/dev/xschem-claude/src/startup_quiz.tcl: startup_quiz::at_launch -> launch_decision (catch) -> pure decide, gate order no-display / automation / nolog / off / no-questions; load_bank is called only after the first four gates pass; have_tk tests `info commands winfo` before `winfo exists .`; automation reads ::cli_opt_pipe and answers 0 when it is absent; launch_delay 400, launch_retry 200, launch_tries 25; launch_show waits on `![winfo viewable .] || [grab current] ne {}`, returns if .startup_quiz exists, then `catch {show}`; no grab and no tkwait anywhere in the file. pick's three pools, eligible (uplevel #0 expr, raise or non-boolean = 0), order_options (tf {0 1}, Fisher-Yates, `last` pinned), grade's seven branches giving the six sentences, answer -> mark_done -> write_done (skipped when automation), write_pref via pref_changed, load_conf with `uplevel #0 [list source $p]`, pref_notice and hint_text quoting "Toggle tip of the day at startup".

C HOOK, read in Tcl_AppInit (src/xinit.c) of both trees: order is source_tcl_file(cli_opt_tcl_script) -> launch_library_manager autostart -> the `xschem load_new_window` loop -> tcleval(cli_opt_tcl_post_command) -> `if(cli_opt_quit)` exit -> `if(has_x)` hook -> END PROCESSING USER OPTIONS. The private tree has the identical tail without the hook, has the cli_opt_nolog mirror, has the C int cli_opt_pipe (xschem.h, globals.c, options.c) and has no tclsetvar("cli_opt_pipe"). Each of the three F5 anchors (`source_tcl_file(cli_opt_tcl_script)`, `tcleval(cli_opt_tcl_post_command)`, `"exit %d", exit_code`) occurs once in the private xinit.c.

WIRING SITES in src/xschem.tcl, src/actions.csv, src/Makefile.in, src/xschemrc, tests/run_regression.tcl are as the map says (read in `git show d36cb429e`). Private anchors all found by grep: the caught `source $XSCHEM_SHAREDIR/ciw.tcl`, proc xschem::notify_degraded_once, the Help lines "Command palette" and "About XSCHEM" in build_widgets, `set selectcolor` in build_widgets, `set_ne raw_history_max 20`, `wviewer::rawhist_load`, `set_ne XSCHEM_START_WINDOW {}`, proc set_ne, fuzzy_subseq_score, the 11-name header of actions.csv, `put /local/install_shares` in Makefile.in, list names tcases/hcases/dcases. `diff` of the two actions.csv files shows ONLY the two help rows.

SUITE, read whole (tests/headless/test_startup_quiz.tcl): bands and arms as the map lists them; counted arm ends at L1 (which itself starts one child xschem with --nogui); display arm adds L2-L14 and D1-D43 incl. D33b, D37b-d; three uppercase `SKIPPED:` sites; prints `RESULT: ALL PASS` then `OVERALL: ok ($npass checks)`, exit 1 on failure; the P_* helpers are defined in the suite; A15 is one row per question through `proves`; A17 only tests for a `[`; A12/A13 anchor the helpers both ways; thresholds A3/A5/A6/A7/A8/A9/A11/A19 as stated. Registered once in hcases and once in dcases of this tree.

BANK NUMBERS, recomputed by my own script over HEAD's bank: 82 entries; tf shipped 27 / upcoming 8 / myth 10; mc howto 35 / upcoming 2; 26 topics; the four at the cap of 6 are ASE-L, CIW and action log, Waveform viewer, Calculator; 6 conditional (4 `[namespace exists ::cadence]`, 2 sky130); every mc entry has 4 options; right option written first in 34 of 37 mc entries; longest q 151, why 414, option 86, topic 18.

80 OF 82 PROOFS AGREE, re-derived independently (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-analog-dev-xschem-claude/478872cd-9a2b-4322-b146-d62b97914d06/scratchpad/quiz_skeptic/pd.tcl, source text only): 259 P_ calls evaluated per tree; the only calls that differ are in quiz-switch (5) and quiz-close (1). The bodies of 13 procs used live by proofs (annot_lbl_launch_ase, ase::backend_names, ase::ui::lbl_plot_outputs, plot_dest_labels, lbl_waveform_viewer, calc::sel_rows, calc::meas_verb, wviewer::sw_bound, ase::register_backend, load_input_bindings, load_input_bindings_file, generate_keybindings_text, palette_refilter) are textually identical; only ngspice is registered through ase::register_backend there; no voice/recipe namespace; the eyeDiagram catalogue row is the same. wrong.claim: Precedence of the switch: --preinit, xschemrc, set_ne default, saved file, --script, --command, hook.

Full order as read: --preinit, xschemrc, --tcl, [xschem.tcl: set_ne default, then load_conf], postinit_commands, --script, extra files, --command, hook.
